newsitem.title: USA: Copper, brass service center shipments unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Copper, brass service center shipments unchanged.

text.p: The copper and brass service centers' average daily shipping rate of copper and copper alloy products during June was unchanged from a month ago and unchanged from last year's corresponding period, according to the Copper & Brass Servicenter Association.
Year-to-date copper and brass ill product shipments are 9.0 percent ahead of last year.
January-June copper sheet, coil and strip shipments are up 19.8 percent from a year ago. Alloy rod and bar shipments for the the first half of the year were up 9.3 percent year-to-year.
June copper product inventories were down 4.6 percent from May. Total product inventories were unchanged.
